added_lines: What if the biggest measure of IT success wasn’t how quickly teams recover from outages—but how rarely outages happen in the first place?

In his latest OpenText blog, Travis Greene explores the path to autonomous IT operations management, where trusted data, unified observability, and governed AI work together to prevent incidents before users are impacted. The future of IT isn’t faster firefighting—it’s incident prevention.
